ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Dominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) surface area exceeding 90% of visible pixels; high-intensity (white/grey) pixels isolated to localized scarring, abrasions, and distal tip accumulations.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Uniform dark pigmentation base; discrete high-contrast white/light-grey circular clusters on the medial and distal sections of the right lobe; linear high-intensity streaks across the central and right lobe surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped central depression dividing the two lobes; deep indentation with sharp convergence at the interior axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Irregular serration pattern with distinct peaks and valleys; highest frequency of visible serrations on the superior trailing edge of the right lobe; left lobe trailing edge partially obscured by water spray.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature along the trailing boundary extending from the median notch to the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly textured, multi-tonal (white/orange/brown) pixel clusters at the distal tips of both lobes; scattered circular white pixel groups on the right lobe surface consistent with barnacle attachment sites.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Multiple distinct white linear pixel disruptions; prominent vertical and diagonal rake marks visible on the mid-to-lower sections of the right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive biological colonization (barnacles) localized at the terminal points of both lobes; irregular light-grey pigmentation patch on the central-right lobe surface.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique brown/tan biological growth embedded within the white clusters at the extreme distal tips.
